jobPlaceholder: Paste the full text of the job posting here.
englishOnly: This checker reads English. It compares the words in your resume with the words in the posting, so use an English resume and an English job posting.
comparing: Comparing your CV with the posting
needBoth: Add your CV and the full job description.
privacy: Your CV is read in this tab. Nothing is stored.
verdictPartial: Partial match. A tailoring pass is worth it.
scoreNote: Combined from skills, keywords, and experience signals in your CV and this posting. It is a coverage score, not a prediction that you will get an interview.
strongEmpty: No named skills from the posting showed up on your resume yet.
missingEmpty: Your resume mentions every named skill we could read from the posting.

tips.addSkill: Add {skill} inside a bullet you can honestly evidence, not only a skills list.
tips.useWording: Use the posting's wording for "{term}" if that work is already on your CV under different words.
tips.years: The posting asks for {years} years. Put the matching roles near the top so that number is easy to find.
tips.level: The posting reads as {level}. Lead with the closest title and scope you actually held.
tips.proveSkill: Keep {skill} in a result bullet with a number, so it is proof rather than a claim.
tips.covered: Your CV already covers the posting's main terms. Check that each one sits in a bullet with a result attached.

ctaHigh.title: Lock this match into a tailored CV
ctaHigh.body: Your match is strong. Keep this posting and rewrite your CV against it, using the experience you already have.
ctaHigh.label: Tailor my CV

ctaGaps.title: Close these gaps
ctaGaps.body: Keep this posting and FitMyCV rewrites your CV and cover letter against it, using the experience you already have.
ctaGaps.label: Close these gaps
